section_summary.extract_value: This section details the materials and measures used in a single study. It describes the Gratitude Questionnaire-Six-Item Form (GQ-6), the National Institute of Health Toolbox Adult Social Relationship Loneliness Scale, the Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10), and the 14-item Physical Health Questionnaire (PHQ). The section also notes that listwise deletion was applied to correlations for a sample size of n = 584. Figure 1 illustrates a serial mediation model, presenting unstandardized coefficients for the relationships between gratitude, loneliness, perceived stress, and impaired physical health.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire provided text and Figure 1.

Asset Caption.extract_value: Figure 1. Serial mediation model showing the sequential mediation effects of loneliness and perceived stress on the association between gratitude and physical health. Unstandardized coefficients (B) are presented. *p < .001, **p < .0001.
